# D192 snapshot routes: complete saved panel tables

18 October 2026. [Interpretation](SNAPSHOT_ROUTES_PANEL_RESULTS.md).
Mechanically rendered from the pinned, saved-audited [summary](/mnt/bioIce1/PlasticHeredity/codex.lawsConfirmation/L22-snapshot-routes-panel-v1/outputs/l22_snapshot_routes_v1_panel_attempt1/SUMMARY.json).

All four exposed histories, all 64 records and both families remain.
Each fresh read-noise set has four paired draws per record; new_mean
weights the two sets and four blocks equally. These are not new founders.
Neither old read outcomes nor disposable 603191 enter these means.

Recognition and partner recognition are percentages; preference and
signed changes use percentage-point units. Other metrics use native
units. Gains/harms/ties use record means, not independent founders.
Omission means are descriptive sensitivity checks, not intervals.
